project_type: NestJS 11 REST API (TypeScript) backed by Neon Postgres via Drizzle ORM; part of the d:\dev\kontabb monorepo (api + web). This task is API-only.
build_system: Nest CLI (webpack). Build with `npm run build` (nest build). Package manager is pnpm (postinstall runs scripts/patch-cte-schema.js), but npm scripts work. Run from d:\dev\kontabb\api.
test_framework: Jest + ts-jest. Config is inline in package.json: rootDir=src, testRegex=.*\.spec\.ts$. Extraction specs embed verbatim extracted-PDF text as string fixtures and assert parsed fields (no real PDF I/O at test time).
test_command: npm test   (single spec: npx jest src/rh/<file>.spec.ts)
verification_instructions: 1) After parser/controller/service/schema edits run `npm run build` to confirm types compile. 2) Run the affected specs: `npx jest src/rh/rh-extraction.spec.ts src/rh/rh-ferias-extraction.spec.ts src/rh/rh-adiantamento13-extraction.spec.ts`. 3) After the migration run `npm run db:check` to confirm drizzle state is consistent (no drift). 4) Finally run the full `npm test` and `npm run build`. Do NOT run `npm run db:migrate` (hits a live DB).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Drizzle migrations are hand-written SQL in drizzle/ (next number is 0032; latest is 0031_unique_electro.sql). drizzle-kit state is tracked in drizzle/meta/_journal.json and drizzle/meta/NNNN_snapshot.json. Preferred: run `npm run db:generate` to emit 0032_*.sql + 0032_snapshot.json + journal entry from the edited schema.ts. If hand-editing, the check constraint lives in the snapshot checkConstraints block as {"chk_folhas_tipo": {"name": "chk_folhas_tipo", "value": "\"folhas_pagamento\".\"tipo\" IN ('FOLHA_MENSAL', 'FERIAS')"}}; new snapshot needs a fresh top-level id and prevId = previous snapshot's id.
environment_constraints: Do NOT run db:migrate (live Neon DB). Neon HTTP driver has no interactive transactions, so all multi-row persistence uses a single raw-SQL CTE via this.database.db.execute(sql`...`). Reference PDFs are at d:\dev\kontabb\api\13 SAL.pdf and d:\dev\kontabb\api\FOLHA 13 SALARIO.pdf. Any throwaway fixture-extraction script MUST be deleted after use.
